mapper.insert: INSERT INTO company_reviews (contract_id, reviewer_company_id, reviewed_company_id, rating, comment) VALUES (#{contractId}, #{reviewerCompanyId}, #{reviewedCompanyId}, #{rating}, #{comment})
mapper.select: SELECT id, contract_id AS contractId, reviewer_company_id AS reviewerCompanyId, reviewed_company_id AS reviewedCompanyId, rating, comment, created_at AS createdAt FROM company_reviews WHERE reviewed_company_id = #{reviewedCompanyId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM company_reviews WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND reviewer_company_id = #{reviewerCompanyId}
